title: Migratory shorebirds
text: Shorebirds such as ruddy turnstones breed on Arctic tundra and winter on coasts as far south as Australia, including reef flats. Losing winter feeding grounds hurts the Arctic breeding population.
when: Breed on the Arctic tundra in summer, then travel south for the northern winter.
matters: Their long trip depends on a few feeding stops. Losing winter feeding grounds hurts the Arctic breeding population.
